cues.en: The Dutch cycle tracks are of course great for people cycling.
cues.zh: 荷兰的自行车道当然非常适合骑车的人。

cues.en: They are safe enough for small children,
cues.zh: 对小孩子来说也足够安全，

cues.en: and they are so safe that children only slightly older can cycle around unsupervised.
cues.zh: 而且安全到稍大一点的孩子可以无人看管地骑车到处跑。

cues.en: Even going fast, as an avid cyclist
cues.zh: 即便骑得很快，对热衷骑行的人来说

cues.en: is also no problem on a well designed cycle track.
cues.zh: 在精心设计的自行车道上也不成问题。

cues.en: They can be used by young and old,
cues.zh: 年轻人和老年人都能用，

cues.en: but the cycle tracks are good for other reasons too.
cues.zh: 但自行车道的好处还不止这些。

cues.en: They offer unexpected
cues.zh: 它们能提供意想不到的

cues.en: protection.
cues.zh: 保护。

cues.en: This little boy can run around freely,
cues.zh: 这个小男孩可以自由奔跑，

cues.en: which he could never have directly next to fast moving motorized traffic.
cues.zh: 而他绝不可能在疾驰的机动车旁这样做。

cues.en: And this guy must think the cycle tracks were especially built for him.
cues.zh: 这位大概觉得，这些自行车道是专为他修的。

cues.en: But there is a large group of people who really benefit from the cycling infrastructure in The Netherlands.
cues.zh: 但有一大群人，确实受益于荷兰的自行车基础设施。

cues.en: People with disabilities
cues.zh: 残障人士

cues.en: use them to go from a to b, giving them a huge freedom.
cues.zh: 用它们从 A 点到 B 点，获得极大的自由。

cues.en: Because with special vehicles adapted to their specific needs,
cues.zh: 因为有了按他们具体需求改装的特殊车辆，

cues.en: they can get out by themselves in safety.
cues.zh: 他们能安全地独自出门。

cues.en: Even in the center of the cities in heavy traffic,
cues.zh: 即使是在城市中心、交通繁忙的地方，

cues.en: the cycling infra makes it safe for them too. With
cues.zh: 自行车基础设施也让他们同样安全。在

cues.en: some supervision
cues.zh: 一些看护

cues.en: or little help, disabled people in The Netherlands enjoy a great freedom to get out.
cues.zh: 或少量帮助下，荷兰的残障人士就能享受外出的巨大自由。

cues.en: And to a very high age,
cues.zh: 一直到高龄，

cues.en: Some of the vehicles could also be used on the road.
cues.zh: 有些车辆也可以在道路上使用。

cues.en: But most of the mobility scooters are perfectly okay to use on the cycle tracks.
cues.zh: 但大多数电动代步车完全可以在自行车道上使用。

cues.en: The mobility scooters go almost as fast as people cycling,
cues.zh: 电动代步车的速度几乎和骑车的人一样快，

cues.en: and the width of the average cycle track in The Netherlands
cues.zh: 而荷兰普通自行车道的宽度

cues.en: is enough to overtake them if necessary.
cues.zh: 必要时足够超过去。

cues.en: The cycle tracks offer great opportunities
cues.zh: 自行车道提供了很好的机会

cues.en: to get out into nature and to have some physical exercise
cues.zh: 走进自然、锻炼身体

cues.en: at least some fresh air,
cues.zh: 至少呼吸点新鲜空气，

cues.en: even when you are a little less able.
cues.zh: 即使你行动不太方便。

cues.en: And of course, you can go with a friend too.
cues.zh: 当然，你也可以和朋友一起去。
